name: Subagent Handoff Output Guard
description: Applies subagent artifact delivery policy, persists Feishu delivery state, blocks tombstoned artifacts, and sanitizes outward handoff text.

enabledChannels.description: Message channels where handoff trailers should be sanitized.

confirmationPromptTemplate.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. Confirmation prompts are now rendered by the requester-agent announce path.

stagingPrefix.description: Requester-workspace relative directory used for immutable subagent artifact copies. Defaults to artifacts/imports/subagent.

maxArtifactsPerHandoff.description: Maximum artifact count across the complete handoff. Defaults to 1.

artifactProfiles.description: Artifact handoff profiles. Built-in profiles can be overridden by id and new profiles can be added.

removeExportPathFromBody.description: Remove requester workspace paths and artifacts/... path fragments from visible message text.

pendingStatePath.description: Workspace-relative JSON file used to persist the latest subagent artifact delivery state. Defaults to .artifacts/state/pending-artifact-handoff.json.

pendingTtlMs.description: Pending and tombstone state TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 86400000.

exportPrefix.description: Single artifacts/-relative export prefix accepted for persisted export paths. Overrides the built-in researcher and PPTX prefixes.

exportPrefixes.description: Artifacts/-relative export prefixes accepted for persisted export paths. Overrides exportPrefix and the built-in researcher and PPTX prefixes.

openclawRoot.description: OpenClaw state root used to derive workspace paths when the hook context does not include workspaceDir.
